heading: Pine Labs block deal: Mastercard Asia-Pacific to sell entire stake worth nearly ₹890 crore: Report
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Mastercard will liquidate its holdings in Pine Labs through a  ₹890 crore deal, offering shares at  ₹179.50 on 22 September. This action coincides with Pine Labs' stock recovery and profit growth from increased digital payment adoption and UPI usage in India.
